info.name: Current user profile and org memberships

items.docs: Returns the signed-in user's profile and organization memberships. Requires a dashboard session token; API keys cannot call this endpoint.

info.name: Pending org invites addressed to the signed-in user's email

items.docs: Returns unexpired pending invites whose invited email matches the session's email. Requires a dashboard session token; API keys are org service accounts and cannot hold or accept invites.

info.name: Accept a pending org invite (session only)

items.docs: Creates the membership for the invite addressed to the session's email in the given org, then consumes the invite. This is the only way an invite becomes a membership: the invitee must be authenticated with the invited email and act explicitly.

info.name: Decline a pending org invite (session only)

items.docs: Decline a pending org invite (session only)
Requires a signed-in dashboard session token; API keys cannot call this endpoint.

info.name: Create the caller's profile and first org (idempotent)

items.docs: Requires a signed-in dashboard session token; API keys cannot call this endpoint.

info.name: The current principal and the org it acts in

items.docs: Returns the calling principal (API key or user session) and the organization the request acts in. For an API key that org is fixed by the key; for a session it is the active org, and availableOrgs lists every org the user belongs to. Unlike /v1/me this works for API keys and does not onboard.
